description: An 8-bit coin-pickup voice: a square wave that jumps to a second pitch part-way through the note, shaped by a hold-and-release envelope

params.text: Sets the starting pitch, from 54 semitones below C4 at 261.63Hz to 54 semitones above it
Sets how far the pitch jumps when the note reaches the time set by TIME, from 24 semitones down to 24 semitones up
Sets how long after the trigger the pitch jumps, from 0ms to 400ms
Adds a burst of extra level at the start of the note which fades away across the hold stage; the knob starts at 100%, above the 60% maximum it is configured with
Sets how long the envelope holds at full level before the release begins, from 1ms to 250ms
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall in a straight line from full level to nothing, from 0ms to 250ms

inputs.text: Adds to the starting pitch set by FREQ at one volt per octave, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Adds to the pitch jump set by FMOD at one volt per octave, read at the moment the jump happens
Doubles the time set by TIME per volt and halves it per volt below zero, up to a ceiling of 800ms, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Doubles the time set by HOLD per volt and halves it per volt below zero, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Doubles the time set by REL per volt and halves it per volt below zero, read at the moment the trigger arrives
Starts a note when it rises past 2V, and has to fall back below 0.1V before another note can start

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V at the moment the pitch jumps
The envelope as a voltage from 0V to 10V, quantised to 127 steps
The voice, quantised to 127 steps and clipped at 5V either way

notes: With nothing patched into the TRIG input the envelope is held wide open and the square wave drones. It only shapes the sound once a trigger cable is in.
The starting pitch, the jump time, the hold, the release and the punch are read once, at the moment the trigger fires; the pitch jump itself is read when the jump happens.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.5:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
